import collections
import text

int[] score(string hand)
    ranks := text.characters("23456789TJQKA")
    cards := hand.split(" ")
    counts := array(15, fill = 0)
    is_flush := true
    for card := cards[]
        rank_index := ranks.index(card[0])
        counts[rank_index + 2] += 1
        if card[1] != cards[0][1]
            is_flush = false
    present := [for rank := counts.indices()[] if counts[rank] > 0 then int(rank)]
    pattern := counts[present].sorted(descending = true)
    wheel := present == [2, 3, 4, 5, 14]
    straight := #present == 5 and (present[4] - present[0] == 4 or wheel)
    category := 0
    if straight and is_flush
        category = 8
    elif pattern[0] == 4
        category = 7
    elif pattern == [3, 2]
        category = 6
    elif is_flush
        category = 5
    elif straight
        category = 4
    elif pattern[0] == 3
        category = 3
    elif pattern == [2, 2, 1]
        category = 2
    elif pattern[0] == 2
        category = 1
    sequence := present.sorted(by = (counts[present], present), descending = true)
    if straight and wheel
        sequence = [5, 4, 3, 2, 1]
    return [category].concat(sequence)

hands := [
    "9C 9D 5H QH 2C",
    "4D AH 3C 5S 2H",
    "KS 8S 2S JS 6S",
    "7H 7D KC 7S KD",
    "3H 6C 4S 2D 5C",
    "JD TC 4H 8C AS",
    "QC 6D QS 3S 6H",
    "9H KH 9S 8H 3D",
]
categories := [
    "high card", "one pair", "two pair", "three of a kind", "straight", "flush", "full house",
    "four of a kind", "straight flush",
]
keys := [for hand := hands[] then score(hand)]
records := [for index := hands.indices()[] then (hands[index], keys[index])]
order := collections.lex_order(keys, descending = true)
ranked := records[order]
for: (hand, key) := ranked[position]
    println("{position + 1}. {hand}: {categories[key[0]]}")
